Sources & methodology

Facts first, especially when names collide

Research checked August 10, 2026. Every gameplay claim on this site must match Cinema Tycoon by THEAM STUDIOS, not another game with the same name.

Correct game identity

This site covers Cinema Tycoon by THEAM STUDIOS, universe ID 3770099349 and root place ID 10311324146. This identity check prevents mechanics from unrelated Roblox, PC, mobile, or browser games from entering the guide.

Advertisement

Primary sources

  • Official Roblox experienceGame identity, goal, rooms and themes, drive-in progression, saving, and group reward.
  • Official developer update logLoading behavior, vehicles, Settings toggles, and the rebirth interface.
  • Official developer creditsTeam credits published by the developer.
  • Official THEAM STUDIOS groupCreator identity and group destination.

Supporting sources

  • Robipedia game dataUniverse identity, pass categories, and public API data.
  • Pro Game Guides overviewGame-specific support for the guest-income loop.

Claims deliberately excluded

We do not publish exact prices, a “best” purchase order, a complete theater-theme list, current player or visit numbers, live pass prices, exact rebirth multipliers or reset rules, NPC-income effects, or untested active codes.

We also exclude claims about daily rewards, offline earnings, AFK income, ticket pricing, customer satisfaction, movie scheduling, concessions inventory, and prestige currencies because none was verified for this exact experience.
